Finance and Economic Management stated that, in preparing the MTEF, all line departments

should assume that government of Vanuatu revenue allocated to line ministries will increase by] the estimated inflation rate (2.8 percent) over the period 2013-16. Based on this information the

government's estimated resource envelope for health will increase slightly from VT 1.575 billion

in 2013 to VT 1.665 billion in 2016. In developing the MTEF for the MoH, it is assumed that the

allocation to health will be at about 11 percent of total government revenue. Any MTEF that is

developed provides an opportunity for government - and its development partners - to better

align scarce resources with the existing and future health challenges of Vanuatu, and to situate

MoH expenditure on health within the broader fiscal and macroeconomic environment facing

Vanuatu now and in the coming years.
